claim.reason: string; overlaps another agent's seed claim

stop_report.text: end-of-turn report; phase-2 stop hook, no MCP tool

action.repeat: claim only: 3 (issue the refused claim 3 times within the wait window)
action.task_key: seed task key; required for task_update (harness maps to task_id; worker is pulled_by), optional otherwise

expect.deterministic_human: bool; true => route needs_human (hard rule: credentials, permissions, spending, destructive/irreversible, addressed to the human)
expect.record_keys: answerable only: seeded decision/memory keys that settle it; a pointer set hits if it includes any

case.seed: standard seed (notices, contracts, decisions, memory, tasks, claims, active_agents); claims always contain exactly one claim on .tirith/lead by the lead agent (jev-lead); 5-20 records
case.uncertain: optional string: why the label is a judgment call

current.notes: 58 blind-labeled cases (esc-labeler, no Jev). The harness does not support the site yet: load_cases reports escalation.json as unknown site, so `--validate` exits non-zero until main.rs adds it. Standalone validator: scratchpad/escalation/validate.py in the jev-lead session scratchpad.
